content: Kahineta Ma7o

Kahineti Geeshsha Dunkaaniyan oothiya wode ma7ana boncho ma7ota, kaalosen, ocha teera daaniya qacinapenne zo7o qacinan daddidosona. Aaroni ma7iya kahinetetha ma7uwa Goday Muse kiitidaysada oothidosona.
Qassi efuudiya, worqafe, kaalosepe, ocha teera daaniya qacinape, zo7o qacinapenne al7o liinope daddidosona.
Enti worqaa qoxidi, lee7isidi, iya qaraaridi, qacinada kessidosona. Yaatidi kaalosen, ocha teera daaneysan, zo7o qacinaninne al7o liinon alleeqisidi daddidosona.
Enti nam7u hashiyara wodhidi, nam7u bagga woli gathidi oysethanaw maaddiya qangota efuudiyas oothidosona.
Goday Muse kiitidaysada, hiillanchoy alleeqisida dancoyka efuudey oosetidaysatape oosetidi, worqan, kaalosen, ocha teera daaneysan, zo7o qacinaninne al7o liinon dadetis.
Enti margide geetetiya shuchata giigisidi, worqafe oosetida kaquwa bolla wothidosona. Maatame bolla woocidi xaafeysada, he shuchata bolla Isra7eele nayta sunthaa woocidi xaafidosona.
Goday Muse kiitidaysada, tammanne nam7u Isra7eele nayta qofisiyaba gidana mela enta, efuudiya qangotan wothidosona.
Tiran Ma7etiya Ma7o
Enti, tiran ma7etiya ma7uwa efuudey oosetidaysatape oothidi, efuudiyada alleeqisidosona.
Iyaw oyddu maazaneti de7oosona; geesaynne gompay issi issi takadho gididi, dakoyetees.
Iya bolla oyddu maaran inqo geetetiya al7o shuchata wothidosona. Koyro maaran sardiyoone, toophazenne phooliya al7o shuchata;
nam7antho maaran baluure, sanparenne almaaze geetetiya al7o shuchata;
heedzantho maaran yaakinte, kelqedoonenne ametesxinoosa geetetiya al7o shuchata;
oyddantho maaran birille, margidenne yasphide geetetiya al7o shuchata wothidosona. Hessata ubbaa worqafe oosetida kaquwa bolla wothidosona.
Tammanne nam7u shuchata bolla issi issi Isra7eele nayta sunthay woocetidi xaafetis.
Tiran ma7etiya ma7uwas walahi bayna worqafe wodoroda dooqada santhalaata ootha.
Nam7u worqa kaqotanne nam7u worqa sagaayota medhidi, nam7u worqa sagaayota tiran ma7etiya ma7uwas qommo baggan de7iya maazanetara gathidi oysethidosona.
He nam7u worqa santhalaatata nam7u worqa sagaayotara gathidi oysethidosona.
He santhalaatata, hanko bagga xeeraa, nam7u kaqotara gasethidosona. Yaatidi, efuudiyas sintha baggara, hashiyara wodhiya qangotara gathidi qachidosona.
Qassi nam7u worqa sagaayota medhidi, efuudiyas sintha baggara de7iya tiran ma7etiya ma7uwas, gaatha baggara de7iya nam7u maazaneta xeeran aathidosona.
Hessadaka, worqafe hara nam7u migiddota oothada, efuudiyas sintha bagga hashiyara wodhiya qanguwas garsa baggara, sikuwa matan dancuwaafe qommo baggara oysethidosona.

Goday Muse kiitidaysada, tiran ma7etiya ma7uwa bolla de7iya migiddota efuudiyan de7iya migiddotara gathidi, kaalose qacina qachidosona. Tiran ma7etiya ma7oy xeessafe qommon pee7iya gisho qashoy dol7enna.
Hara Kahine Ma7ota
Efuudiyape bollara ma7etiya adussa ma7oy kumethi kaalose afilape giigisidosona.
He adussa ma7uwas huuphe aathiya luho medhidi, peedhetonna mela guye qalam7idi, yuushshi aathidi sikidosona.
Adussa ma7uwas duge bagga macara yuushuwan kaalosen, ocha teera daaniya zo7o qacinaninne al7o liinon, oromaane teera misileta medhidosona.
Enti walahi bayna worqafe daalata medhidi, adussa ma7uwas duge bagga gaxan, oromaane misileta giddon wothidosona.
Goday Muse kiitidaysada, oromaane teera misileta, adussa ma7uwas duge bagga macaraa yuushuwan aathidosona.
Enti, Goday Muse kiitidaysada, Aaronasinne iya naytas, shamizeta,
huuphe qaceta, uketanne gaatha sureta al7o liinope daddidi giigisidosona.
Qassi dancuwa kaalosen, ocha teera daaniya qacinan, zo7o qacinaninne al7o liinon alleeqisidi, giigisidosona.
Enti, geeshsha kallacha misiliya walahi bayna worqafe medhidi, iya bolla, “Godaas Dummatis” giya qaala woocidi xaafidosona.
Yaatidi, Goday Muse kiitidaysada, huuphe qaciya bolla kaalose qacinara qachidosona.
Oosoy Gaxa Gaketha
Geeshsha Dunkaaniya ooso ubbay kumethi poletis. Isra7eele asay, Goday Muse kiitidaysada oothidosona.
Hessafe guye, enti Geeshsha Dunkaaniyanne iya miisheta Museko ehidosona. Hessatika, kaceta, tuussata, liyoota, tuuqetanne enti eqiya tohota.
Bolla kamaas, zo7o qalamen yeggidi kessida dorsa ite, haashetida do7a ite, magarajuwa,
Tammu kiitata oykida Taabotiya, iya tookiya kaso mithatanne nagara atotetha kamaa,
xarpheezanne iya miisheta ubbaa, Godaa sinthan de7iya geeshsha daabbuwa,
walahi bayna worqafe oosetida xompe wothiya kocaa, iya bolla de7iya xompeta, iya miisheta ubbaanne xompe zayte,
worqafe oosetida yarsho bessi, shuumatetha zayte, sawiya ixaane, Geeshsha Dunkaaniya penge magarajuwa,
naase biratape oosetida yarsho bessi, naase birata teqiya, tooho kaso mithatanne iya miisheta ubbaa, meecha kerenne iya wotheysa,
dabaaba geliya penge magarajuwa, tuussatanne, enti eqiya tohota, dabaaba magarajuwa, tole wodorota, dhisheta, Geeshsha Dunkaaniyan go7etiya miisheta ubbaa,
kahineti Geeshsha bessan ma7iya boncho ma7ota, Aaroninne iya nayti ma7iya kahinetetha ma7ota.
Isra7eele asay ooso ubbaa, Goday Muse kiitidaysada oothidosona.
Asay, ooso ubbaa, Goday kiitidaysada oothidaysa Musey be7is. Hessa gisho, Musey enta anjis.
